results.title: A manifest from a different build
results.evidence: a manifest declaring `manifest_version: 99` — a version this build does not write (it writes 1) — was restored without a word, while a manifest missing a SECTION is refused by name. The version field is written into every manifest and read by nothing, so a backup from a future build whose sections have moved is restored optimistically and the parts this build cannot see are silently skipped
